name: tv-remote
description: Personal PWA remote control for iFFALCON Android TV

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @tv-remote/server" "npm run dev -w @tv-remote/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @tv-remote/shared && npm run typecheck -w @tv-remote/streamdesk-protocol && npm run typecheck -w @tv-remote/server && npm run typecheck -w @tv-remote/streamdesk-desk && npm run typecheck -w @tv-remote/web && npm run typecheck -w @tv-remote/streamdesk
scripts.test: npm run test -w @tv-remote/shared && npm run test -w @tv-remote/streamdesk-protocol && npm run test -w @tv-remote/server && npm run test -w @tv-remote/streamdesk-desk && npm run test -w @tv-remote/web && npm run test -w @tv-remote/streamdesk
scripts.build: npm run build -w @tv-remote/shared && npm run build -w @tv-remote/streamdesk-protocol && npm run build -w @tv-remote/server && npm run build -w @tv-remote/web && npm run build -w @tv-remote/streamdesk
scripts.android: npm run cap:sync -w @tv-remote/web && npm run cap:open -w @tv-remote/web
scripts.streamdesk:dev: concurrently -n desk,mobile -c green,magenta "npm run streamdesk:desk" "npm run streamdesk:mobile"
